body.statement: If \(\Delta_j=0\) for every active cell and the two active full-cell conditional problems have identical primitives, then, under the complete signed-cell conditional law, every cell's unique individually optimal weight is \(\theta_{0j}=\arctan(b_{2j}/b_{1j})\), the two cell envelopes coincide, and the unique holdout fraction is \(1-\rho_0\).
body.justification: This is the required reduction to proportional Gaussian information weighting.
body.gap: It is a sanity-check corollary rather than an independent novelty claim.
body.consumer: It lets implementers validate the general optimizer against a closed-form symmetric benchmark.
